name: VideoVault Premiere Extension
releaseNotes:
- August 5, 2026
- adds a full-resolution source checkout workflow for editors who need local 4K media instead of proxy-only playback
- lets editors return a project back to server-linked source paths before handoff from the same panel
- makes the new 4K checkout controls visible directly in the main ready-to-work views
- adds Checkout 4K Sources so the panel can copy all tracked project source media into local VideoVault storage and switch Premiere onto those local files
- adds Return To Server so the same project can be relinked back to NAS source paths before the next handoff
- shows clearer source status when a project is in shared mode, full-resolution local mode, or a mixed recovery state
- keeps the existing proxy workflow available for projects that still cut cleanly on proxies
- this release is intended to ship on both Windows and macOS
- teams moving between proxy work and full-resolution work should update all editor machines to the same release
